design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are diagnostic-classification latent classes rather than ILSA achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but makes no mention of whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses student-level models without addressing school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and only describes internal validation strategies.
